title: The Fluent speech in the hall
subtitle: 语言文化 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 语言文化（人与社会·历史社会与文化·语言与文化）
meta: 主题语境：语言文化（人与社会·历史社会与文化·语言与文化）　|　核心词汇：fluent　|　正文 339 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 fluent 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1976 the warden wrote of ① a fluent speech in the hall in the register, and everybody in the centre said at once that it was ② fluenter than the one named there the year before. Three months on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the warden, who never explained anything, had done it in silence and gone home; it was the fluent ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the fluentest speech in the hall anybody in the centre had ever seen, or so the register for June 1970 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too fluent to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the resident who had come to help; the fluent ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the notice at the far gate, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a fluent English of the old man, and said that no resident in his right mind would call it ⑥ as fluent as the English of the old man they had once had in the old centre. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was fluent or not, and he said so.

By 1983 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the register. What the line asked for was ⑦ something fluent, and nothing besides. The resident from the next centre called the whole plan ⑧ quite fluent; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the register kept the names of the fluent ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1986, twice over, she wrote of another fluent speech in the hall in the same register, and the work, which took two months, seemed ⑨ fluenter than anybody had expected. ⑩ The fluentest English of the old man in the whole centre, she said in 1988, was the one she could never quite name; the fluent ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 流利（前置定语 a fluent speech in the hall：1976 年管理员在登记册里记下的那件流利的发言）
B. adj. 流利／流畅（比较级 fluenter than：文中两处，一处比厅里流利的发言，一处比预想）
C. adj. 流利／流畅（最高级 the fluentest：文中两处，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 流利（表语 too fluent to do：母亲觉得它太流利，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 流畅（前置定语 a fluent English of the old man：叔叔把整件事称作一桩流畅的英语）
F. adj. 流畅（同级比较 as fluent as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩老人流利的英语相比）
G. adj. 流畅（后置定语 something fluent：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 流畅（受程度副词修饰 quite fluent：那位居民的评价）

items.q: a fluent speech in the hall
the fluentest speech in the hall anybody
a fluent English of the old man
The fluentest English of the old man in

answers.why: fluent 意为“流利”，1976 年管理员在登记册里记下的是“一件流利的发言”，此处作前置定语 a fluent speech in the hall。
fluent 意为“流利”，此处用比较级 fluenter than，拿它跟前一年记下的那一个相比。
fluent 意为“流利”，登记册上 六月 那行字说它是社区中心里最流利的一件，故用最高级 the fluentest speech in the hall。
fluent 意为“流利”，母亲认为这件东西“太流利了，谁也用不上”，too fluent to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
fluent 意为“流畅”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩流畅的英语”，此处作前置定语 a fluent English of the old man。
fluent 意为“流畅”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩老人流利的英语一样流畅”，同级比较用 as fluent as。
fluent 意为“流畅”，登记册上那半行字要的是“流畅的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something fluent。
fluent 意为“流畅”，邻社区中心来的那位居民认为这套计划“相当流畅”，quite 修饰原级 fluent。
fluent 意为“流畅”，1986 年那趟活儿“比任何人预想的都要流畅”，故用比较级 fluenter than。
fluent 意为“流畅”，母亲 1988 年说的是“整个社区中心里最流畅的那一桩”，故用最高级 the fluentest English of the old man。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1976 年，管理员在登记册里记下了一件流利的发言。（a fluent speech in the hall）
人人都说它比前一年记下的那一个更流利。（fluenter than …）
母亲觉得它太流利，谁也用不上。（too fluent to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩流畅的英语。（a fluent English of the old man）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩老人流利的英语一样流畅。（as fluent as …）
到了 1983 年，登记册上只剩半行字：要的是一件流畅的东西。（something fluent）
answers: In 1976 the warden wrote of a fluent speech in the hall in the register.
Everybody said it was fluenter than the one named there the year before.
My mother thought it too fluent to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a fluent English of the old man.
He said nobody would call it as fluent as the English of the old man they had once had.
By 1983 the register asked for nothing but something fluent.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 fluent 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1976 the warden wrote of a fluent speech in the hall in the register, and nobody forgot it.
It was the fluentest speech in the hall in the centre, or so the register says.
My mother thought it too fluent to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a fluent English of the old man, and nobody argued with him.
The resident from the next centre called the plan quite fluent, and everybody laughed.
The fluent ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
